chart.name: chart.quality.control.points
chart.title: Control Points
chart.dataset:
SELECT COUNT(self.id) AS _passed, (CASE WHEN(translation.message_value = '') THEN _meta._select_title ELSE translation.message_value END) AS _status FROM quality_control_point AS self
JOIN (SELECT cast(_item.value as int) AS _select_value, _item.title AS _select_title FROM meta_select AS _selection JOIN meta_select_item AS _item ON _selection.name = 'quality.control.points.status.select' AND _item.select_id = _selection.id ) AS _meta ON _meta._select_value = self.status_select JOIN meta_translation as translation ON translation.message_key = _meta._select_title AND translation.language = :_language WHERE DATE(self.created_on) BETWEEN DATE(:fromDateT) AND DATE(:toDateT) GROUP BY _status ORDER BY _passed ASC

chart.name: chart.quality.controls.total.numbers
chart.title: Number of quality control by team
chart.dataset: SELECT COUNT(*) AS _controls, self.team.name AS _team FROM QualityControl self WHERE DATE(self.createdOn) BETWEEN DATE(:fromDateT) AND DATE(:toDateT) GROUP BY self.team.name ORDER BY self.team.name

chart.name: chart.quality.alerts.total.numbers
chart.title: Number of quality alerts by team
chart.dataset: SELECT COUNT(*) AS _alerts, self.team.name AS _team FROM QualityAlert self WHERE DATE(self.createdOn) BETWEEN DATE(:fromDateT) AND DATE(:toDateT) GROUP BY self.team.name ORDER BY self.team.name

chart.name: chart.quality.alerts.solved.total.numbers
chart.title: Number of solved quality alerts by team
chart.dataset: SELECT COUNT(*) AS _alerts, self.team.name AS _team FROM QualityAlert self WHERE DATE(self.createdOn) BETWEEN DATE(:fromDateT) AND DATE(:toDateT) AND self.statusSelect = 4 GROUP BY self.team.name ORDER BY self.team.name

chart.name: chart.quality.improvements.costs.distributions.per.decision
chart.title: Distribution of costs per decision
chart.dataset: SELECT self.decision AS decision,SUM(self.totalCost) AS total_cost FROM ( SELECT _qi_decision.name AS decision,SUM(_qi_resolution_decision.total_cost) AS totalCost FROM quality_qi_resolution_decision AS _qi_resolution_decision LEFT JOIN quality_qi_decision _qi_decision ON _qi_decision.id = _qi_resolution_decision.qi_decision LEFT JOIN quality_qi_resolution _qi_resolution ON _qi_resolution.id = _qi_resolution_decision.qi_resolution LEFT JOIN quality_quality_improvement _quality_improvement ON _quality_improvement.qi_resolution = _qi_resolution.id WHERE _quality_improvement.id = :id GROUP BY _qi_decision.name UNION ALL SELECT _qi_decision.name AS decision,SUM(_qi_task.total_cost) AS totalCost FROM ical_event AS _qi_task LEFT JOIN quality_qi_decision _qi_decision ON _qi_decision.id = _qi_task.qi_decision LEFT JOIN quality_qi_analysis _qi_analysis ON _qi_analysis.id = _qi_task.qi_analysis LEFT JOIN quality_quality_improvement _quality_improvement ON _quality_improvement.qi_analysis = _qi_analysis.id WHERE _quality_improvement.id = :id GROUP BY _qi_decision.name ) AS self GROUP BY self.decision

custom.name: quality.improvements.costs.lists.per.decision
custom.title: Costs list per decision
custom.dataset: SELECT self.decision AS decision,SUM(self.fixedAmount) AS fixed_amount,SUM(self.directCost) AS direct_cost,SUM(self.totalCost) AS total_cost FROM ( SELECT _qi_decision.name AS decision,SUM(_qi_resolution_decision.fixed_amount) AS fixedAmount,SUM(_qi_resolution_decision.direct_cost) AS directCost,SUM(_qi_resolution_decision.total_cost) AS totalCost FROM quality_qi_resolution_decision AS _qi_resolution_decision LEFT JOIN quality_qi_decision _qi_decision ON _qi_decision.id = _qi_resolution_decision.qi_decision LEFT JOIN quality_qi_resolution _qi_resolution ON _qi_resolution.id = _qi_resolution_decision.qi_resolution LEFT JOIN quality_quality_improvement _quality_improvement ON _quality_improvement.qi_resolution = _qi_resolution.id WHERE _quality_improvement.id = :id GROUP BY _qi_decision.name UNION ALL SELECT _qi_decision.name AS decision,SUM(_qi_task.fixed_amount) AS fixedAmount,SUM(_qi_task.direct_cost) AS directCost,SUM(_qi_task.total_cost) AS totalCost FROM ical_event AS _qi_task LEFT JOIN quality_qi_decision _qi_decision ON _qi_decision.id = _qi_task.qi_decision LEFT JOIN quality_qi_analysis _qi_analysis ON _qi_analysis.id = _qi_task.qi_analysis LEFT JOIN quality_quality_improvement _quality_improvement ON _quality_improvement.qi_analysis = _qi_analysis.id WHERE _quality_improvement.id = :id GROUP BY _qi_decision.name ) AS self GROUP BY self.decision

chart.name: chart.quality.nc.open.by.gravity
chart.title: Number of open non-conformities by gravity
chart.dataset: SELECT COUNT(self.id) AS _count, COALESCE( (SELECT item.title FROM MetaSelectItem item WHERE item.select.name = 'quality.qi.gravity.type.select' AND item.value = CAST(self.gravityTypeSelect AS string)), 'Not defined') AS _gravity FROM QualityImprovement self WHERE self.qiStatus.isClosedStatus = false AND self.qiStatus.isCancelledStatus = false AND (:_company IS NULL OR self.company = :_company) AND DATE(self.createdOn) BETWEEN DATE(:fromDateT) AND DATE(:toDateT) GROUP BY self.gravityTypeSelect ORDER BY self.gravityTypeSelect

chart.name: chart.quality.receptions.conformity
chart.title: Reception conformity rate
chart.dataset: SELECT COALESCE( (SELECT item.title FROM MetaSelectItem item WHERE item.select.name = 'stock.move.line.conformity.select' AND item.value = CAST(self.conformitySelect AS string)), 'Not assessed') AS _status, COUNT(self.id) AS _count FROM StockMove self WHERE self.typeSelect = 3 AND self.statusSelect = 3 AND (self.isReversion IS NULL OR self.isReversion = false) AND (:_company IS NULL OR self.company = :_company) AND DATE(self.realDate) BETWEEN DATE(:fromDateT) AND DATE(:toDateT) GROUP BY self.conformitySelect ORDER BY self.conformitySelect

chart.name: chart.quality.top5.suppliers.nc
chart.title: Top 5 suppliers with most non-conformities
chart.dataset: SELECT self.qiIdentification.supplierPartner.fullName AS _supplier, COUNT(self.id) AS _count FROM QualityImprovement self WHERE (:_company IS NULL OR self.company = :_company) AND DATE(self.createdOn) BETWEEN DATE(:fromDateT) AND DATE(:toDateT) GROUP BY self.qiIdentification.supplierPartner.id, self.qiIdentification.supplierPartner.fullName ORDER BY COUNT(self.id) DESC

chart.name: chart.quality.top5.products.nc
chart.title: Top 5 products with most non-conformities
chart.dataset: SELECT self.qiIdentification.product.code AS _product, COUNT(self.id) AS _count FROM QualityImprovement self WHERE (:_company IS NULL OR self.company = :_company) AND DATE(self.createdOn) BETWEEN DATE(:fromDateT) AND DATE(:toDateT) GROUP BY self.qiIdentification.product.id, self.qiIdentification.product.code ORDER BY COUNT(self.id) DESC

chart.name: chart.quality.nc.monthly.trend
chart.title: Number of non-conformities by month
chart.dataset: SELECT TO_CHAR(self.createdOn, 'YYYY-MM') AS _month, COUNT(self.id) AS _count FROM QualityImprovement self WHERE (:_company IS NULL OR self.company = :_company) AND DATE(self.createdOn) BETWEEN DATE(:fromDateT) AND DATE(:toDateT) GROUP BY TO_CHAR(self.createdOn, 'YYYY-MM') ORDER BY TO_CHAR(self.createdOn, 'YYYY-MM')

chart.name: chart.quality.control.entries.open
chart.title: Number of open control entries
chart.dataset: SELECT COUNT(*) AS _count, (SELECT item.title FROM MetaSelectItem item WHERE item.select.name = 'quality.control.entry.status.select' AND item.value = CAST(self.statusSelect AS string)) AS _status FROM ControlEntry self WHERE self.statusSelect IN (1, 2) AND DATE(self.entryDateTime) BETWEEN DATE(:fromDateT) AND DATE(:toDateT) GROUP BY self.statusSelect ORDER BY self.statusSelect

action-view.name: action-quality-view-nc-open-by-gravity
action-view.title: Open non-conformities
action-view.domain: self.qiStatus.isClosedStatus = false AND self.qiStatus.isCancelledStatus = false AND (:_company IS NULL OR self.company = :_company) AND DATE(self.createdOn) BETWEEN DATE(:_fromDateT) AND DATE(:_toDateT) AND ((:_gravity = 'Critical' AND self.gravityTypeSelect = 1) OR (:_gravity = 'Major' AND self.gravityTypeSelect = 2) OR (:_gravity = 'Minor' AND self.gravityTypeSelect = 3) OR (:_gravity = 'Not defined' AND self.gravityTypeSelect = 0))

action-view.name: action-quality-view-receptions-conformity
action-view.title: Receptions
action-view.domain: self.typeSelect = :_typeSelect AND self.statusSelect = :_statusSelect AND (self.isReversion IS NULL OR self.isReversion = false) AND (:_company IS NULL OR self.company = :_company) AND DATE(self.realDate) BETWEEN DATE(:_fromDateT) AND DATE(:_toDateT) AND ((:_status = 'Compliant' AND self.conformitySelect = 2) OR (:_status = 'Non-compliant' AND self.conformitySelect = 3) OR (:_status = 'Not assessed' AND (self.conformitySelect = 0 OR self.conformitySelect = 1)))

action-view.name: action-quality-view-nc-by-supplier
action-view.title: Non-conformities
action-view.domain: (:_company IS NULL OR self.company = :_company) AND DATE(self.createdOn) BETWEEN DATE(:_fromDateT) AND DATE(:_toDateT) AND self.qiIdentification.supplierPartner.fullName = :_supplier

action-view.name: action-quality-view-nc-by-product
action-view.title: Non-conformities
action-view.domain: (:_company IS NULL OR self.company = :_company) AND DATE(self.createdOn) BETWEEN DATE(:_fromDateT) AND DATE(:_toDateT) AND self.qiIdentification.product.code = :_product

action-view.name: action-quality-view-nc-by-month
action-view.title: Non-conformities
action-view.domain: (:_company IS NULL OR self.company = :_company) AND DATE(self.createdOn) BETWEEN DATE(:_monthStart) AND DATE(:_monthEnd)

action-view.name: action-quality-view-control-entries-open
action-view.title: Open control entries
action-view.domain: self.statusSelect IN (:_draftStatus, :_inProgressStatus) AND DATE(self.entryDateTime) BETWEEN DATE(:_fromDateT) AND DATE(:_toDateT) AND ((:_status = 'Draft' AND self.statusSelect = :_draftStatus) OR (:_status = 'In progress' AND self.statusSelect = :_inProgressStatus))
